purpose: Controls that must run outside any AI/model decision. A control returning indeterminate blocks auto-posting and creates an evidence request or approval task.

controls.requirement: Every record, source file, model request, policy, and provider credential is scoped to one organization and engagement.
Retain an immutable raw-source snapshot reference and SHA-256 hash before normalization.
controls.evidence: source URI, hash, received time, provider object ID

controls.requirement: Record source system, entity type, provider version, retrieval time, and as-of time.
Advance a CDC cursor only after the complete page set is persisted and reconciled; retain deleted-object tombstones.
controls.evidence: cursor, page counts, object counts, snapshot IDs

controls.requirement: Never use CDC as the sole recovery path after its permitted look-back period or an incomplete run; trigger a bounded backfill/reconciliation workflow.
A tax-sensitive or material transaction must name the exact missing evidence instead of treating an OCR/model inference as evidence.
Store the source-document-to-ledger lineage, including document version and relevant page/field coordinates where extracted.
Every proposed double-entry posting balances exactly in Decimal currency arithmetic.
Posting date, currency, account, class/project, customer/vendor, and tax references must be valid for the configured company and transaction type.
A closed/locked period, inactive target, unsupported entity, or unbalanced correction cannot be auto-posted.
Detect exact and near duplicate source documents and provider transactions before proposing a write.
An automatic match requires deterministic amount, currency, direction, account, date-window, and uniqueness checks; otherwise it is a proposal.
Tax rate decisions must be effective-date and fact dependent. Unknown place of supply, supply nature, registration status, or tax evidence blocks the tax conclusion.
controls.evidence: tax facts and cited rule version

controls.requirement: ITC evidence checks are separate from expense coding. Passing bookkeeping classification does not imply a supportable ITC claim.
The model receives a minimized, tenant-scoped state and an atomic typed question; its response is stored with model/provider/version and confidence.
Confidence thresholds are calibrated per workflow and client policy using held-out reviewed decisions; no global threshold is assumed correct.
A model response may choose only from deterministic, policy-eligible options. It cannot invent accounts, tax codes, vendors, amounts, or write operations.
Every proposal records the client policy version, rule IDs, exceptions, and effective dates used to produce it.
The required approver is selected by workflow risk, materiality, novelty, tax/payroll sensitivity, and separation-of-duties policy.
The actor who prepared a controlled transaction cannot silently approve and release it when separation is required.
All provider writes use an idempotency key, the current concurrency token where required, and a bounded retry policy limited to safe transient failures.
controls.evidence: request ID, idempotency key, concurrency token

controls.requirement: No delete operation, fund release, payroll execution, tax filing, payee creation, or tax-setting change is eligible for autonomous execution in the base product.
Read the provider object after every write and compare it to the exact approved payload; a mismatch produces a compensating-action proposal, never a silent overwrite.
Reconcile source, normalized transaction, proposed posting, execution, and provider state before marking work closed.
Append an audit event for source acquisition, decision, approval, mutation, read-back, correction, and deletion/retention action.
A human correction creates a versioned rule candidate and evaluation case. It cannot change production behavior until tested, reviewed, approved, and released.
controls.evidence: correction, candidate rule, test outcome, approval

controls.requirement: No financial data is sent to a model provider until provider purpose limitation, retention, security, cross-border processing, customer disclosure, and consent/contract gates pass.
controls.evidence: approved provider assessment and data-sharing policy
